description: Spin a wheel of choices with Perkadoo's Spin the Wheel and land on one, like a prize, a name or where to eat. A choice listed twice has two slices. Uses public drand randomness, so anyone can check it. Returns where it landed and a public results link to share.

slices.description: The wheel's slices: an array, or text with one slice per line.

title.description: What the wheel decides, shown on the results page.
